_doc: Single source for tools/preflight.py and tools/grid_cut.py. Values from docs/layer_ladder.md, docs/asset_qa.md, riverwalk/look.lua and claude/art-learnings.md. Change rules here, not in the scripts.

char.outline: a 1 px dark outline around the whole silhouette, one ink colour

play.outline: a 1 px dark outline around the whole silhouette, one ink colour

back.outline: no outline; its edges are a darker shade of its own colour

mid.outline: no outline; its edges are a darker shade of its own colour

front.outline: a dark silhouette with a thin rim of light on the top edge

riverwalk.light: River Walk, a summer morning by a city river: warm low sun from the upper left, golden highlights, cool blue shadows

citypark.light: City Park, a golden autumn afternoon: warm amber sun from the upper left, warm highlights, violet-blue shadows

downtown.light: Downtown, a bright midday: high white sun from the upper left, crisp short shadows, clean saturated colours

art_direction: Art direction: the 1994 Lion King console game (SNES / Mega Drive): hand-placed pixels, very crisp, cute and friendly for a 7 year old. Image 2 shows approved sprites from this game: match their pixel size, outline, shading and palette, but do not copy them or add them. Front-on side view. Flat fills shaded in ramps of 3 to 4 shades per material, the darkest shade a neutral dark. No anti-aliasing, no gradients, no dithering, no texture noise, no lone specks.
